name: Gargantilla del Lozoya y Pinilla de Buitrago (Spain)
description: Red field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Gargantilla del Lozoya y Pinilla de Buitrago (a bull on white and a tree on yellow above waves).
history: Municipal flag of Gargantilla del Lozoya y Pinilla de Buitrago; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Gargantilla del Lozoya y Pinilla de Buitrago arms — bull on white and tree on yellow above waves
